title: The Vanished Multitude
intro: You stand before the echoes of a community whose story is written in the waves. These souls heard a call, chose defiance, and faced a consequence that reshaped the earth. Who are they, and what became of their world?
clues: We lived long ago, and a messenger came to us from among ourselves.
We worshipped five idols and refused to abandon them.
We mocked the messenger and accused him of being astray.
We demanded he bring the punishment if he was truthful.
We saw the skies pour down rain and the earth gush forth springs.
We climbed to the high places to escape, but the waves overtook us.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: We were drowned in a great flood
We were destroyed by a hurricane
We were killed by a loud blast
We were swallowed by the earth
We were pelted with stones from the sky
trial.answer: We were drowned in a great flood

outcome.label: Outcome
options: We all perished except the believers with Nuh
We were left as ruins for travelers
outcome.answer: We all perished except the believers with Nuh

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
